cta.text: SOME STORIES FIND YOU. SUBSCRIBE FIRST.

lines.text: He knew my name. Nobody lives out here.
Old patrol uniform. A badge from 1987.
lines.say: Old patrol uniform. A badge from nineteen eighty-seven.

lines.text: Son, you've been on this road for 39 years.
lines.say: Son, you've been on this road for thirty-nine years.

lines.text: Every night you pass marker 214. Never 215.
lines.say: Every night you pass marker two fourteen. Never two fifteen.

lines.text: I laughed. Then his flashlight hit my car.

lines.say: Rust. Flat tires. Plate R.T. nine, nineteen eighty-seven.

lines.text: Then the GPS spoke. It wasn't a machine.
lines.say: Then the G.P.S. spoke. It wasn't a machine.

lines.text: It was my mother. Turn around, sweetheart.
She recorded that the night I left. In 1987.
lines.say: She recorded that the night I left. In nineteen eighty-seven.

lines.text: So this time, I turned the car around.
Mile marker 215. For the very first time.
lines.say: Mile marker two fifteen. For the very first time.

lines.text: But in my mirror, a blue car just passed 214.
lines.say: But in my mirror, a blue car just passed two fourteen.
